name: kdenlive
description: The Kdenlive package is a KDE Frameworks-based video editor that can handle numerous video and audio codecs.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF                \
      -D FETCH_OTIO=ON                    \
      -W no-dev .
